cases.setup: A localized deterministic bug has clear behavior, one public seam, and no product decision.
cases.expected: Use compact Shape/Spec/Slice and avoid unnecessary orchestration.

cases.setup: A real product or one-way architecture trade-off is unresolved.
cases.expected: Codex asks the user; neither AGY nor Sol High invents the decision.

cases.setup: Codex has completed Shape/Spec/Slice and the user did not opt out of plan review.
cases.expected: Use sol-high-plan-review through Chrome DevTools MCP before PLAN FROZEN.

cases.setup: The user explicitly says to skip Sol review and execute the Codex plan directly.
cases.expected: Skip ChatGPT Web review, record PLAN FROZEN, then continue to baseline and AGY.

cases.setup: Rounds 1 and 2 returned REVISE; round 3 still has unresolved blocking disagreement.
cases.expected: Stop after round 3 and ask the user with a compact decision brief; never start round 4.

cases.setup: PLAN FROZEN is recorded and AGY has started implementation.
cases.expected: Never call Sol High during Build, Review, Rework, Verify, Closeout, or Acceptance.

cases.setup: AGY returns SUCCESS but repository evidence does not satisfy the frozen plan.
cases.expected: Codex remains in Review/Rework; never treat AGY runtime completion as delivery proof.

cases.setup: Spec Fidelity and Engineering Quality pass but a required caller is missing.
cases.expected: Completeness REWORK makes the overall review REWORK_REQUIRED.

cases.setup: Three-Axis Review passes but Codex independent integration verification fails.
cases.expected: Create V* finding, AGY rework, full Three-Axis Review again, then Verify again.

cases.setup: A browser-facing task requires runtime verification after Review PASS.
cases.expected: Codex may use Chrome DevTools MCP for runtime evidence; it is not an AGY writer dependency.

cases.setup: Browser runtime verification is required but MCP and equivalent seams are unavailable.
cases.expected: Do not issue CODE_VERIFIED; report the missing verification evidence.

cases.setup: Review and Verification pass after an API contract change but README still documents the old contract.
cases.expected: Do not ACCEPT until knowledge closeout is aligned.

cases.setup: The Sol skill directory contains SKILL.md but is missing required nested references or scripts.
cases.expected: Run the versioned manifest preflight, classify the state as INCOMPLETE, and do not open ChatGPT Web until the full skill is available.

cases.setup: The user asks to use an already-open Chrome session that contains unrelated tabs.
cases.expected: Leave unrelated tabs untouched, verify or create a ChatGPT tab in the same session, and hand authentication to the user when needed.

cases.setup: A plan-review packet is ready in ChatGPT Web.
cases.expected: Visibly verify GPT-5.6 Sol and High, automate preparation only, require final Send confirmation, and treat UNKNOWN or a missing sentinel as non-success without resending.

cases.setup: AGY init reports the target repository cwd but a later tool command runs from the CLI home.
cases.expected: Treat init.cwd as insufficient, stop relative-path writes, and recover with an absolute command-level cwd check.

cases.setup: Headless AGY receives a write permission denial while the task still needs one bounded edit.
cases.expected: Record the real conversation and permission evidence, use a narrow tty7 one-off approval, and never use --dangerously-skip-permissions.

cases.setup: AGY exits with a CLI or feedback error after an edit tool visibly ran.
cases.expected: Inspect Git for partial writes, then use Codex Review and independent verification; do not equate the CLI error with no change or auto-replay.

cases.setup: The working tree already contains user-owned changes before AGY implementation.
cases.expected: Capture baseline paths and patch/fingerprint before writes, then verify original hunks survived at closeout.
